newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar pares losses despite NY fall.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar pares losses despite NY fall.

text.p: London white sugar futures ended lower but trimmed losses at the close on Monday despite a sharp drop in New York raws.
The front-month May contract ended the day $1.20 a tonne lower at $308.00 but was off an intraday low of $307.40, staving off some of the bearish effect of the New York slide.
Turnover on the session totalled 1,430 lots.
Attentions have turned to the upcoming expiry of the March contract in New York.
Traders were also watching news on the strike in the key Brazilian port of Santos which started on Monday but only a small percentage of exports are said to be affected.
